# Recording B counter authority and receipt design

**Source review only, 14 October 2026.** No counter implementation or recording is authorized by this note. The 128-row eligibility page established one correct collection/generic/React trace and native delta operations `[1,1,1,2]`; it measured neither latency nor scaling. Its `vdom.keyed-region-delta.released-child-vnodes: 128` is an `array.length` read before clearing an old reference, not 128 visits. The full Recording B proposal remains subject to primary approval. This note applies to all twelve proposed edit kinds at **128, 1,024, and 10,000**: head/middle/tail insert, head/middle/tail remove, head/middle/tail move, same-key rotation, edge replacement, and N/2 global filter. It does not relabel the historical 413-source lock, 424-entry eligibility input lock (source and tooling), served assets, or dense v1 pages.

## Count window and receipt

For each `(size, editKind, trial)`, restore canonical order **within the same page root**, preserving retained row incarnations and local state; do not remount the root per trial. Verify the reset, set sentinel state, settle pending work, and prepare immutable operations **before** the window. A removed key later reinserted during reset is a new incarnation, so receipt identity expectations distinguish it from continuously retained keys. Record `collection.stats()` and diagnostic cumulative baselines after this reset. Open the count gate immediately before `collection.apply(expectedVersion, operations)`; close it after the synchronous `root.flush()` returns **including** publication, refs, and effect callbacks. Do not inspect DOM, call `collection.snapshot()`/`VDOMSnapshotRoot.snapshot`, run integrity checks, or perform the next reset inside. Capture counter and stats end values after gate closure; subtract begin values. Record actual start/end versions, apply result, flush result, dirty/pending status, and any thrown error even on failure. Do not call `resetStats()` during or between paired deltas; `KeyedCollection.stats` is cumulative from mount and its `resetStats()` does not clear retained history/readers (`keyed_collection.ts:454-473`). Distinct untimed receipts cover initial mount, each reset/sentinel preparation, inspection, and teardown; a counter in one of those windows is never charged to the edit.

Per-edit proposed receipt (schema, not a file format mandate):

```text
{ protocolId, sourceLock, assetLock, compilerProofLock, size, editKind,
  pageId, trialId, warmup, arm:"native-collection-count", N, K,
  expectedVersion, appliedVersion, resultingSize, orderedOutputCount,
  window:{start:"before-apply", end:"after-sync-flush", completed},
  route:{exclusivePath, eligibility, bailReason, readerBatchCount,
         fallbackEntered, fullReconcileEntered},
  counts:{name:{value, authority:"iteration|event|length|estimate",
                 site, window:"edit"}},
  collectionStatsBefore, collectionStatsAfter, collectionStatsDelta,
  bucketStatsBefore, bucketStatsAfter, bucketStatsDelta,
  semantic:{identity, state, output, effects, refs, disposal},
  errors, cleanupErrors }
```

One receipt per operation per trial, with **exactly one** exclusive root route (`collection-delta`, `mixed`, `partial-owner`, `structural-owner`, `numeric`, `full-reconcile`, `no-commit`, `error`) and a nested VDOM route. Counter names must carry a unit and source-site authority; never sum overlapping events/lengths into a total visit count. Missing counters are `null` with a reason, not zero. Commit failure, fallback, multiple root flushes, unexpected async work, or mismatched source/assets invalidates that edit/page. Count controls are separate native pages, never timing pages; React render probes are absent from qualified latency pages. Pages and paired blocks, not trials or rows, are latency units.

Generic expansion discovers/visits components at `:5692-5740`. | Increment at each actual owner-slot probe, lookup hit/miss, and each parent-link iteration; separate delta/generic caller contexts. Record unique owner IDs visited and executed only as bounded diagnostic sets outside timed pages. Existing `owner.component-visits/renders`, `owner.created/retired` are events at `:4220-4221,:4421,:4515,:5692,:5734,:5865`; generic visit is component-node encounter, not necessarily execution. `collection.owner-membership-writes` counts successful Set mutations, not attempted lineage visits. |

Existing `collection.rows-prepared` increments on published non-null overlay entries, including retained replacements, and misses removed-row work. Count `world.destroyOwner` recursive visits (`owner_state_world.ts:1982+`) separately from `owner.retired` event. Do not count user effect body iterations as runtime-owned work. |

Keep generic route token work separate from delta route. Count cache map clear entries only if actual loop/API traversal is known; `Map.clear` is an event/size, not measured iterations. |
| VDOM preparation/normalization/key | `vdom_snapshot_runtime.ts:278-308` recursively normalizes input; `prepareKeyedRegionDeltas` at `:1582-1775` clones operations, checks root/region ancestry, virtual presence, scalar bindings, unique keys, old subtree collection; `#commitKeyedRegionDelta` at `:1375-1568` repeats guards/validation. `#rebuildKeyIndex` at `:4645-4662` already counts actual mounted-node visits when profile callback exists. | Count actual `normalizeMany` input nodes/returned VNodes and `validateUniqueKeys` nodes, candidate/mounted subtree visits, ancestor-link iterations, region candidates, key-index attach/detach calls, key/rank lookups, scalar-prop validation iterations, and each bail reason. Keep prepare and commit counts disjoint; prepared nodes avoid normalization in commit. Full `prepareCommit` (`:1092-1125`) and `reconcileChildren` (`:740-823`) need mounted/next child loop visits on fallback. `vdom.key-index.full-rebuild-visits` is an actual iteration, while `vdom.keyed-region-delta.operations` is an array length. |
| Bucket order/rank/slot | `keyed_region_buckets.ts:45-52,89-165,171-191,231-269` exposes cumulative slot reads/writes, splits/merges and bucket count. The default capacity is 128 slots; `#reindex` writes each entry; splice/array spread/slice can shift or copy slots internally. | Take bucket stat deltas from same retained region instance, or add a diagnostic root accessor without exposing production internals. Count actual bucket-entry loops/yields in `entries`/`forEach`, anchor/key map probes, offset/rank repair loop iterations, and bucket traversal. The existing `bucketSlotWrites` aggregates estimated shifted slots with explicit reindex writes; new instrumentation must report these **separately**, and also report actual JS loop iterations separately. `bucketCount` is a gauge; split/merge are events. No rank claim from `bucketSlotWrites` alone. |
| Binding and host | `vdom_snapshot_runtime.ts:1499-1548` mutates bucket/host; binding attach/detach/index increments at `:4003-4080`, and `#rebuildBindingIndex` at `:4325+`; `DOMVDOMHost.place` at `:5024-5032` returns early for already-correct position, otherwise `insertBefore`; `remove` is conditional. | Count place **attempts, effective `insertBefore`, no-op returns**, remove attempts/effective removals, element/text creations, prop/style/text writes, host disposal attempts/success/failures, and binding-group/source loops separately. VDOM binding index “operations” are registrations/index events, not unique row visits. A move can invoke `place` yet make no DOM change. Avoid extra DOM reads in the diagnostic hook: classify using existing `parentNode/nextSibling/lastChild` branches. |
| Refs, disposal, recovery | `vdom_snapshot_runtime.ts:1015-1075` stages/ref flushes, `:451-510` recursively releases subtree and host resources; `:1800-1910` repairs indexes after failed prepared commit. | Count pending ref entries scanned, attach/detach callbacks actually invoked, mounted subtree nodes released, host `dispose` and `remove` outcomes, index repair/fallback events and visits, error path. Final `root.dispose` is **teardown**, outside edit; removal within edit is inside. A failed host mutation and its repair remain in the failed edit receipt, never silently dropped. |

The existing 128 page's generic `owner.component-visits=128` is a single exercised update, while the collection route emitted delta operation counts. Even a small collection-route component-visit count cannot prove zero missing owner lookup, lineage, or VDOM work until those exact sites are instrumented. This page does not bound owner work in all twelve kinds or at the other two sizes. In particular, `released-child-vnodes` at `vdom_snapshot_runtime.ts:1552` is **length**: clearing the array reference there is O(1) in the synchronous edit, while deferred garbage collection is a distinct unmeasured cost. `collection.delta-operations` at `component_state_runtime.ts:4501` is also **length**. Both must stay out of iteration totals. The pure collection route at `component_state_runtime.ts:1968-1990` differs from the mixed collection preparation at `:1948-1965`; the earlier product-mixed fixture drives all retained scalar rows and cannot substitute for the structural-only fixture.

## Disposable instrumentation boundary

Only after primary authorization, make a **new isolated source snapshot** from the exact locked source/build inputs, preserve its before/after SHA manifest, and patch counters there. Do not touch live `src`, the frozen 413/424 input locks, eligibility v2 page/build/assets, dense pages, or any existing v1 tooling. A Vite diagnostic entry must import the actual authored TSX boards/controllers and root through **one canonical snapshot `src` path**; no mixed live and snapshot imports, symlink paths, or second copy of `native_runtime_api.ts`. The earlier gate succeeds because controller and board are in the same Vite bundle (`runtime-gate-v2/vite.config.ts` and its README); a duplicate module instance would split compiler component registration from the root and invalidate counts. Prove one runtime module identity with emitted source maps/module graph and the same compiler site/program IDs as the locked authored source, plus a positive native runtime gate. Use the pinned source-proven Rust/OXC binary and explicit React Compiler path; do not weaken compiler checks. Diagnostic count mode can use per-iteration integer increments but should avoid `performance.now`, per-row allocation, callback dispatch, and DOM inspection in hot loops. Flush one aggregate receipt only after the edit window. A matched diagnostic-off build/page can check build shape and semantics; it does not causally correct latency for probe overhead. Count pages are for structural counts, not timing claims.

The smallest implementation is a gated counter bag on the root, collection, owner world, VDOM and bucket instance, with a narrow private diagnostic accessor for cumulative bucket stats and one status code at each delta fallback. No new semantic registry, container, runtime optimization, or product API. Root authorization is required before writing it. Count probes can change allocation/JIT and therefore their own timing; collect latency only from the probe-free locked build. Host/effect callbacks can synchronously reenter or throw, so the gate should tag nested work by origin and reject unbounded/reentrant edits rather than double count or erase it. Use one invocation per finite page under the 90-second proposal and preserve failures.

## Falsifiers and stop

Require nonnegative integer deltas with complete windows, exact 12-kind × 3-size provenance, stable source/asset IDs, correct output/identity/local state/effect/ref/disposal, and no unlabelled fallback. Preserve raw per-edit receipts; do not report a percentage of wall time from counters or one 128 page. For one-key edits, report actual owner/component visits at each size and normalized visits/N; the proposed descriptive screen is at 10,000 no more than the 1,024 count plus 16 and no more than 64, with >N/4 at either 1,024 or 10,000 a clear full-region failure. Intermediate is unresolved. The N/2 filter has `K=N/2` public remove operations and corresponding owner/host lifetimes, so O(N) work is expected and excluded from the local count screen. If eligible local edits scan N owners, stop at upstream rediscovery. If owner counts are local but sequence/index/binding/token repair grows materially with N, measure that residual before comparing existing array/buckets. If host placement/disposal or necessary global work dominates, report the floor. No asymptotic or physical design conclusion is available until all three sizes and the separate latency/correctness gates pass.
